title: Baobab Organisation Domain Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Target path: baobab-platform/shared/contracts/organisation/v1/domain.schema.json

Contract authority for the generic Organisation and LegalEntityProfile models.

Shared is the contract/schema authority and Nabhold first-party governance source.
Control Plane (baobab-cp) is the runtime authority for Organisation, LegalEntity
runtime representation, and all relationship graphs (ADR-BCP-018).

Invariants preserved:
  Organisation != LegalEntity
  Organisation != Tenant
  Organisation != IAM Organisation
  Corporate ownership != authorization

CanonicalEntity remains the identity spine. Organisation is modelled as a
profile/extension of CanonicalEntity, not a parallel identity system.
BUYER_ORGANISATION and SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION (ADR-BCP-016 / ADR-0006) remain
valid specialised EntityTypes and migrate forward without destructive rewrite.

organisationForm.description: Organisational form (what sort of organisation this is). MUST NOT encode commercial role (SUPPLIER/CUSTOMER etc.). Those are relationships or CounterpartyRoles (ADR-BCP-014).

verificationState.description: Verification state for identity or relationship claims. Consequential decisions MUST fail closed when state is missing, UNVERIFIED, PENDING_REVIEW, CONFLICTED, REJECTED or EXPIRED.

lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status aligned with CanonicalEntity status vocabulary where practical.

organisationIdentifier.description: Jurisdiction-aware legal or regulatory identifier. Uniqueness is (type + jurisdiction + issuer? + value), not value alone.

organisationAddress.description: Address associated with an Organisation. Address presence does not imply market participation or commercial approval.

Organisation.description: Generic real-world Organisation. Anchored to CanonicalEntity (canonical_entity_id). Describes identity and organisational form only; commercial role is expressed via CounterpartyRole / CounterpartyRelationship (ADR-BCP-014) or PlatformRelationship (this ADR).

canonical_entity_id.description: Platform CanonicalEntity identifier. Organisation identity is never independent of CanonicalEntity.

official_name.description: Legal / official name when distinct from display_name.

trading_names.description: Trading names, brands or aliases. Do not create new Organisation records solely because of a trading name.

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction of incorporation or establishment (ISO country or subdivision code preferred).

source_authority.description: Authoritative source that established or last verified this Organisation record (e.g. shared-registry, control-plane-admission, company-registry-provider).

LegalEntityProfile.description: Legally recognised person attached to an Organisation. organisation_id and legal_entity_id remain distinct even when the relationship is one-to-one (ADR-BCP-018). Shared retains governance authority for first-party Nabhold identities; Control Plane is runtime authority for all LegalEntityProfile records.

legal_entity_id.description: Stable legal-entity identifier. For first-party Nabhold entities this is the Shared registry id (NABHOLD, ZURIBEANS, …). For external entities it is Control-Plane-issued.

organisation_id.description: CanonicalEntity / Organisation identifier this legal person is attached to. MUST differ from legal_entity_id in the identifier space even when cardinality is 1:1.

legal_status.description: Legal status (e.g. ACTIVE, DISSOLVED, IN_LIQUIDATION). Exact vocabulary is extensible and jurisdiction-aware.

items.description: Opaque reference to evidence held in a document/evidence system. Binaries are not stored in this contract.
